meta.title: Happy Horse 1.1 vs Seedance 2.0 Fast: Audio, Drafts & Best Uses
meta.description: Compare Happy Horse 1.1 and Seedance 2.0 Fast for native audio, lip-sync, fast Seedance drafts, cost control, scorecard ratings and best production use cases.

en.heroIntro: Use Happy Horse 1.1 when the job is driven by speaking characters, native synchronized audio, lip-sync, and reusable references. Use Seedance 2.0 Fast when you need cheaper Seedance draft passes, timing checks, prompt exploration, and a fast bridge back to the full Seedance 2.0 workflow. This comparison is useful when a team is deciding whether the next test should validate performance and dialogue or simply iterate visual direction faster.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.subtitle: Short answers for choosing between audio-first Happy Horse runs and fast Seedance iteration.

items.question: When should I choose Happy Horse 1.1?
items.answer: Choose Happy Horse 1.1 when the test needs native audio, lip-sync, speaking subjects, or reference characters that must carry the scene.

items.question: When should I choose Seedance 2.0 Fast?
items.answer: Choose Seedance 2.0 Fast for cheaper Seedance prompt tests, draft timing, storyboard exploration, and quick iteration before moving to the main Seedance 2.0 model.

items.question: Which one is better for batch testing?
items.answer: Seedance 2.0 Fast is usually the better fit for many visual draft iterations. Happy Horse 1.1 is better when each batch item must test audio, dialogue, or a character reference.

faq.title: 常见问题
faq.subtitle: 帮助你在音频优先的 Happy Horse 生成与快速 Seedance 迭代之间做出选择。

items.question: 何时应该选择 Happy Horse 1.1？
items.answer: 测试需要原生音频、口型同步、说话主体，或需要由参考角色推动场景时，选择 Happy Horse 1.1。

items.question: 何时应该选择 Seedance 2.0 Fast？
items.answer: 需要更低成本的 Seedance 提示词测试、草稿时序、分镜探索，以及进入 Seedance 2.0 主模型前的快速迭代时，选择 Seedance 2.0 Fast。

items.question: 哪款更适合批量测试？
items.answer: 大量视觉草稿迭代通常更适合 Seedance 2.0 Fast；每条样片都需测试音频、对白或角色参考时，Happy Horse 1.1 更合适。
